subject: Restore isometric combat-observation side-step scoring
description: DONE. Task #80 exposed Nescafe schema-14 Profile_001 Savegame_001 replay-008 frame 1106, where Soldier 178 consumed the same two CombatObserveSideStep RNG draws as Original but selected the opposite perpendicular destination. Original ProposeStepDirectionWhileObservingCombat obtains the observer direction through RHElement::GetDirectionVector, whose SetSector0to15 call uses ASPECT_RATIO, then obtains an aspect-corrected normal and truncates each friend scalar product to SWORD. Rust incorrectly seeded that calculation with the ordinary unit-circle sector_to_vector before applying the isometric normal. It now uses sector_to_vector_iso, matching the source geometry and truncation inputs. The debug replay matches every recorded frame through EOF, all 84 ai_enemy focused tests pass, cargo fmt is clean, and git diff --check is clean.
